items.title: Vanishing of the cup product with the class of a subscheme from vanishing on the subscheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if a cohomology class restricts to zero on a smooth closed subscheme whose conormal class in K theory is a restriction of a class on the ambient scheme, then its cup product with the cycle class of the subscheme vanishes (statement lines 4825-4835). The proof (proof lines 4836-4850) passes to the blowing up, rewrites the pulled back class through the exceptional divisor, and applies the divisor axiom. H2: a complete short argument in three steps.
